_README: Single source of site-wide settings. Change `origin` when the domain is bought, then run `node build.mjs` (output: dist/). Everything absolute (canonical, hreflang, sitemap, OG/Twitter, JSON-LD, robots.txt, llms.txt) is built from it.
_origin_note: workers.dev until a domain is bought (then change it here, add the custom domain in wrangler.jsonc and set workers_dev false)
_playStoreLive_note: Set to true the day the Google Play listing is public. It switches guide CTAs, llms.txt wording and adds the Play URL to structured data (sameAs / installUrl).
_placeholders_note: Leave null to keep {{CONTACT_EMAIL}} / {{OWNER_NAME}} / {{CF_BEACON_TOKEN}} in the output; set a string to fill them in at build time.
_sameAs_note: Official profiles to add once they exist (YouTube channel, X, Product Hunt, AlternativeTo page…). Used in Organization/VideoGame JSON-LD and llms.txt.
